name: Lettuce Sprint XR
summary:
Lettuce Sprint is the first immersive mixed-reality  agricultural simulation in the world, developed by Digi Fuzz Verse in the Food Valley (Wageningen, Netherlands). Designed for intuitive spatial play, it lets you cultivate real lettuce Varieties right inside your physical space using natural hand and controller interactions. Plant your seeds, fine-tune temperature, humidity, soil moisture, and light intensity, and watch your lettuces respond in real time through dynamic digital twins.
